_schema.description: Official contact channels per country, keyed by ISO3 (matching UN_MEMBERS and NON_UN keys in index.html). Each country maps to an array of contact entries. The app auto-generates Wikipedia + CIA Factbook links, so DO NOT add those here — focus on the channels below.

entry_fields.type: one of: gov | mfa | un_mission | head_of_state | parliament | nhri | embassy_directory | social  (required)
entry_fields.label: human-readable name, e.g. 'Ministry of Foreign Affairs' (required)
entry_fields.url: https URL you actually fetched and confirmed returns 200 and belongs to this country (optional but preferred)
entry_fields.email: official email, only if found on an official page (optional)
entry_fields.phone: E.164 or as published on the official page (optional)
entry_fields.source: URL of the page you took this from (required when url/email/phone/address present)

rules: NEVER invent a URL, email, phone, or address. If you did not fetch and confirm it, leave the field out.
Prefer official government / intergovernmental sources over third parties.
Every entry needs a 'source' and a 'verified' date.
Keep the JSON valid at all times; append region by region.
